WITH RECURSIVE factory_nodes AS ( SELECT root.id, root.level FROM mom_mdm.mdm_factory_model root WHERE root.id = #{factoryId} AND root.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND root.type = 'FACTORY' AND root.status = TRUE AND root.del_flag = '0'
UNION ALL
SELECT child.id, child.level FROM mom_mdm.mdm_factory_model child JOIN factory_nodes parent ON child.parent_id = parent.id AND child.level = parent.level + 1 WHERE child.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND child.status = TRUE AND child.del_flag = '0' ) SELECT node.* FROM mom_mdm.mdm_factory_model node JOIN factory_nodes matched ON matched.id = node.id WHERE node.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND node.type = #{type} AND node.id != #{factoryId} ORDER BY node.sort ASC, node.create_time ASC, node.id ASC

WITH RECURSIVE ancestors AS ( SELECT
FROM mdm_factory_model WHERE id = #{nodeId}
UNION ALL
SELECT
FROM mdm_factory_model f INNER JOIN ancestors a ON f.id = a.parent_id ) SELECT * FROM ancestors WHERE id != #{nodeId} ORDER BY level ASC

SELECT
FROM mdm_factory_model WHERE del_flag = '0' ORDER BY level ASC, sort ASC, create_time ASC
